rules: Exact original VWAP RULES/candidate/replay_market/pending_state/evaluate. No modification to volume2x, first strict session reclaim, local stop, structural room, net2R, 4-bar expiry or fees. Original controls must reproduce as full reports.
purpose: Two fixed complete 28-day retrospective periods of the unchanged VWAP specification; no new strategy, retuning, forward sample, sealed-period access or replacement of original future validation.

sealed_periods.scope: No entry/outcome evaluation; warmup prices are indicator inputs only.
No early fetch/evaluation of registered VWAP validation.
Preserve unopened local15 validation prices; no access in this audit.

decision: Evaluate periods separately. Any adequately observed complete period with >=20 resolved and base AvgR<=0 or PF<=1 (tolerance1e-12) rejects this additional historical study, stops subsequent unused period collection and cannot authorize live changes. Failed fetch or no valid indicators blocks study and skips unused period. Below50 each is INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE. All registered selection conditions must hold per period, then original future periods and separate live evidence remain required. No pooling, later best-window selection or replacing first fetched archives.
collection: Only public LAST_PRICE getKline, frozen archived182-market universe, exactly180 closed4H/15M indicator windows. Full 28-day source collection cutoff, no later exit extension. Pre-launch short histories, unavailable markets, candle gaps and funding/queue limitations disclosed. All source files and first manifests frozen before model evaluation; sources are never regenerated to improve results.
limitations: Retrospective publicly reconstructed OHLC; no pristine holdout or captured-live promotion samples.
Archived current market universe has survivorship/listing bias; all182 including unavailable/short histories remain in denominator.
4H warmup may start before interval, but no entries or outcomes before period start.
Funding, bid/ask, queue, price tick, real fills and live account ROI are not modeled.
No pooling daily/cohort repeats or previous studies to meet per-period50 decisions.
Original fixed research portfolio is separate from any live account settings.
